items.title: Every quasi-compact open of an affine scheme with one-dimensional Noetherian local rings is affine
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a quasi-compact open U of an affine scheme whose local rings are Noetherian of dimension at most one is itself affine. The proof lets j : U -> X be the inclusion, takes a quasi-coherent F on U, kills the higher direct images R^p j_*F using the affine-curve lemma, notes that j_*F is quasi-coherent on the affine X and hence has vanishing higher cohomology, and concludes via the Leray spectral sequence that H^p(U, F) = 0 for p > 0, which characterizes affineness for quasi-compact opens (proof lines 7779-7793). H2: the merging of three cited cohomological tools into the vanishing criterion is the substance and is not a one-line citation.
